svg.title: Доброе утро с резинкой — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Resistance-band good morning, three-quarter side view. One long continuous loop exercise band: lower end clearly pinned UNDER BOTH midfeet, upper end across back of shoulders/upper traps behind neck, never across throat. The two taut sides of the loop are clearly visible from soles to shoulders in both frames; hands steady band near shoulders. Left: upright stand with knees slightly bent. Right: buttocks back, torso bends forward from hips, flat back, knees still softly bent same small angle, both feet grounded. NO barbell, dumbbell, or pulley. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
